decisionReason: Non-live probe on a matching Reference Host. Gate 0 requires Screen Recording permission, live display/capture evidence, lifecycle evidence, and Developer ID notarization evidence.

lifecycle.behavior: Live mode will register distributed lock/unlock and NSWorkspace sleep/wake observers, stop capture, invalidate encoders, and release the virtual display. The probe exits after a lock or sleep event. Relaunch manually after unlock/wake and verify no ghost display remains.
manualSteps: Start a live probe with a duration longer than the manual test.
Lock the Mac and confirm the report contains screenIsLocked and cleanup completed.
Unlock the Mac, rerun the live probe, and confirm exactly one new Extended Display appears.
Put the Mac to sleep and wake it, then confirm the previous Extended Display disappeared.
Repeat with System Settings > Displays open and verify no stale DeskMate display remains.

notExecuted: Create and verify a non-mirrored HiDPI Extended Display.
Grant Screen Recording permission and start ScreenCaptureKit from that display.
Encode real-time HEVC and H.264 Annex-B samples with parameter sets and color metadata.
Exercise lock and sleep to prove capture teardown and display cleanup leave no ghost display.
Run Developer ID signing, notarization, stapling, and Gatekeeper assessment.
